children.text: This page reads evidence; it does not run tests. The default candidate status is
. Simulation results are not measured device data. Real Orca with Firefox on Linux remains a separate, unmet human qualification gate for both profiles.
Compare Go model output with retained fixtures
A synthetic fixture is not an experimental measurement
Exercise real indexing, glossary aliases, counts and anchors
Automated behavior is not human screen-reader qualification
Reject unknown sources, changed hashes, unsupported rights and unsafe references
Only the explicit public allowlist is published
Read, search and navigate the actual Go-generated corpus
No blanket scientific Pass or Measured badge
A report must identify the exact source revision, source SHA-256, fixture SHA-256 and tool version. Missing reports show
; importing it is not verification. Only a separately supplied, exact-bound trusted record can show
. Recorded evidence is not a claim of experimental agreement or release qualification.

The browser accepts a small local JSON report for reading only. It does not upload that report, execute its contents, run commands, or persist it automatically. Hosted builds contain no raw private runner receipts.

The educational conductance baseline is 30 levels, configurable, not a verified device-state count. Literature coefficients and synthetic regression assertions must retain their own conditions. The Park-context shape is synthetic regression data, not a digitized measured Park loop; unsupported scalar reports and the disputed BTO trace do not become valid by being read here.
